site.name: greengrove
site.summary: greengrove-clone Fictional pet insurance "GreenGrove" marketing site, including a 6-step quote wizard. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Landing page: hand-drawn dog illustration hero + 3 value props + customer review cards + FAQ entry | | `quote.html` | 6-step quote wizard: 1 pet type (6 icon cards) / 2 breed (200+ dogs, 60+ cats, other species auto-switched ARIA combobox with searchable dropdown — keyboard up/down/Enter/Esc) / 3 age (year/month toggle + stepper) / 4 pre-existing conditions (19 chip multi-select + None toggle) / 5 three tier cards (Sprout / Sapling / Oak) + deductible dropdown + collapsible side-by-side comparison table + live per-tier quote / 6 quote summary (monthly fee + annual total + inclusions + 14-day price lock mock); top 6-step dot indicator allows jumping back; floating Back / Continue bar | | `faq.html` | 12 common-question `<details>` accordion |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the greengrove system, focusing on the 6-step quote wizard (primary flow) and adjacent pages (landing, claims, FAQ), validating interactions, accessibility, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: Start with the landing page (index.html) to assess hero and navigation. Then enter the quote wizard (quote.html) to test all 6 steps, including complex controls (combobox, multi-select, stepper, tier comparison). Check claims.html form and faq.html accordions. Repeat critical checks in mobile viewport.
assumptions: The quote wizard (quote.html) is the primary onboarding flow with 6 steps and complex controls. Adjacent pages (claims.html, faq.html) support the main flow. Mobile viewport has small tap target warnings to validate.
risk_hotspots: quote.html (6-step wizard with ARIA combobox, multi-select, stepper, tier comparison)
small tap targets on mobile for navigation links

phases.title: Landing Page (index.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate hero section, navigation links, and FAQ entry on desktop. Check small tap targets for mobile readiness.
key_checks: Click 'Start a free quote' to ensure it leads to quote.html
Click 'See the FAQ →' to ensure it leads to faq.html
Inspect navigation links (GreenGrove, Get a quote, Claims, FAQ, Sign in) for functionality and small tap targets (mobile viewport)
exit_criteria: All navigation links and CTAs function correctly. Small tap targets identified for mobile validation.

phases.title: Quote Wizard Step 1-3 (quote.html)
phases.objective: Test pet type selection (step 1), breed combobox (step 2, ARIA with searchable dropdown), and age selection (step 3, year/month toggle + stepper) on desktop.
key_checks: Interact with breed combobox (step 2): search, select with keyboard (up/down/Enter/Esc), ensure auto-switch for species
Toggle age to 'month' (step 3), use stepper to adjust age, click 'Continue' to step 4
exit_criteria: Steps 1-3 complete with correct navigation and control functionality.

phases.title: Quote Wizard Step 4-6 (quote.html)
phases.objective: Test pre-existing conditions (step 4, multi-select + None toggle), tier selection (step 5, three tier cards + deductible dropdown + comparison table), and quote summary (step 6) on desktop.
key_checks: Select pre-existing conditions (step 4) or 'None', click 'Continue' to step 5
Select 'Oak' tier (step 5), interact with deductible dropdown, expand comparison table, check live quote, click 'Continue' to step 6
Review quote summary (step 6), check 14-day price lock mock, use dot indicator to jump back to step 3, then forward to step 6
exit_criteria: Steps 4-6 complete with correct navigation and control functionality. Tier comparison and live quote validated.

phases.title: Claims Page (claims.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Test claims form (pet name, visit date, condition, total paid, file upload) on desktop.
key_checks: Fill pet name, visit date, condition, total paid (step 1-4), interact with 'Vet invoice' file upload, click 'Submit claim' (test functionality, no actual submission)
Check navigation links (GreenGrove, Get a quote, Claims, FAQ) for functionality
exit_criteria: Claims form fields and file upload interact correctly. Navigation links function.

phases.title: FAQ Page (faq.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Test accordion functionality (12 common questions) on desktop.
key_checks: Expand/collapse multiple <details> accordions (e.g., 'What's the waiting period?', 'What counts as a pre-existing condition?')
Check navigation links (GreenGrove, Get a quote, Claims, FAQ) for functionality
exit_criteria: All accordions expand/collapse correctly. Navigation links function.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks (quote wizard steps, claims form, FAQ accordions) in mobile viewport. Validate small tap targets and responsive design.
key_checks: Test quote wizard steps 1-6 in mobile: pet type, breed combobox (touch + keyboard), age stepper, pre-existing conditions, tier selection, quote summary
Test claims form (pet name, visit date, file upload) in mobile
Validate small tap targets for navigation links (GreenGrove, Get a quote, etc.) in mobile
exit_criteria: Critical flows (quote, claims, FAQ) function in mobile. Small tap targets validated for usability.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, quote, claims, faq)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all quote wizard steps (6), claims form (5 fields + file upload), FAQ accordions (12), and navigation links
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat quote wizard steps, claims form, FAQ accordions, and navigation checks in mobile viewport

notes: Prioritize the quote wizard (quote.html) as the primary flow. Validate complex controls (ARIA combobox, multi-select, stepper, tier comparison) thoroughly. Check small tap targets for mobile usability.
